hypotheses.rationale: Movement quality may matter more than raw price movement when liquidity is adequate.
hypotheses.rejection_criteria: Do not infer liquidity from fabricated BBO or volume alone.

hypotheses.rationale: Breakouts accompanied by unusual reported activity may persist.
hypotheses.entry: close exceeds prior 20 observed-session highs and volume_ratio_20 >= 1; signal executes next observed session
hypotheses.exit: quarterly-like portfolio rebalance cadence in observed sessions; absent from target set exits
hypotheses.risk: long-only, available cash, approved PIT gate
hypotheses.failure_mode: gap/reversal, volume is not executable liquidity
hypotheses.rejection_criteria: negative net first pass or unstable OOS; spread condition remains untested

hypotheses.rationale: Relative strength leadership may be more useful when market breadth confirms direction.
hypotheses.testability: PARTIAL: positive 20-session momentum rank tested; breadth-conditioned variant not tested because point-in-time eligible cross-section is incomplete and incomparable dates are sparse.

hypotheses.rationale: High movement alone may fail after realistic costs if execution quality is poor.
hypotheses.testability: NEEDS_MORE_DATA: only candle-based cost sensitivity is measurable; no historical spread/depth.

hypotheses.rationale: Short pullbacks in established trends may revert when directional efficiency is low.
hypotheses.entry: five-observation adjusted-close return below -5% while close is above SMA50
hypotheses.exit: quarterly-like portfolio rebalance cadence; absent from target set exits
hypotheses.risk: long-only, available cash, approved PIT gate
hypotheses.rejection_criteria: negative net first pass or unstable OOS; low-directionality condition unverified

hypotheses.rationale: Selective, shallow-to-moderate pullbacks may mean revert when both the stock trend and broad SET50 regime are not weak and recent directional efficiency is low. Lower portfolio churn should retain any signal edge after costs.
hypotheses.entry: 5-session adjusted return in [-8%,-3%], close>SMA50>=SMA100, 10-session directional efficiency<=0.35, SET50 above SMA50 and 20-session return>=-1%; decision at close, entry no earlier than next observed open.
hypotheses.exit: Selection is re-evaluated every five observed sessions; retain unchanged holdings while stock trend and benchmark regime remain valid; otherwise exit at next observed open using RESEARCH_EXECUTION_V1.
hypotheses.portfolio: Top 3 equal-weight positions; no leverage; unchanged names persist; candidate is diagnostic only.
hypotheses.minimum_sample: >=100 events across >=10 symbols, plus chronological OOS evidence before any promotion consideration.
hypotheses.rejection_criteria: Reject signal if sample below threshold, fewer than 3 of 5 mean horizons positive, or all horizons negative. Reject portfolio if net<=0, drawdown>35%, or materially lower turnover is not achieved. No robustness/OOS after a failed stage.

parameter_policy: One fixed specification per candidate; no grid search or tuning on OOS.

multiplicity.warning: Research Round 1 and Round 2 share inspected 2023-2026 history; Round 2 is not independent confirmation. Overlapping signal events inflate naive precision; confidence intervals are descriptive.
